subject: Intro: Redwood demo + traffic/POC questions - Novellus Retail
messages:
From: sam.wright@novellus-retail.com
To: demo@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood — quick context and request

Hi team,

I signed up for the self-serve trial yesterday and poked around the API docs. We're Novellus Retail — building a product search ranking service that uses embeddings and reranking for personalized results. I'm evaluating fast inference options because our monthly query volume could ramp from ~5M to 30M queries over the next 9 months.

High-level asks:
- A quick demo of your hosted and dedicated options (cost/latency tradeoffs)
- Clarify integration path for our Node.js backend + hosted cache strategy
- Any recommended batch/quantization settings for sparse long-tail queries

Can someone from sales/solutions give a 30–40 minute demo next week? I'm in PST (San Francisco).

Thanks,
Sam Wright
Director of Search, Novellus Retail
Attachments: pilot_requirements.xlsx (stub)

Hi Sam — thanks for signing up and for the context. I'm Ben (SDR) at Redwood — looping in Jasmine (AE) to lead the demo. A couple quick questions so we make the session most useful: 

1) Is the 5M -> 30M figure monthly queries or inference tokens?
2) Do you expect traffic to be steady or bursty (e.g., 10x peaks during sales events)?
3) Timeline: are you looking to pilot within 30 days, 90 days, or a longer window?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 2026-07-14, 11:00–11:45
- Thu 2026-07-15, 14:00–14:40
- Fri 2026-07-16, 09:30–10:10

If those don't work, tell us a couple of windows and we'll adjust. Also attaching our short demo guide that covers what we'll show.

—Ben
Ben Carter | SDR, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-demo-guide.pdf (stub)

From: sam.wright@novellus-retail.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.gupta@novellus-retail.com
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — quick context and request

Ben — thanks. Answers below inline.

> 1) Is the 5M -> 30M figure monthly queries or inference tokens?
It's user queries — roughly queries per month. Average tokens per request is ~120 but can spike for some analytical requests to ~800.

> 2) Do you expect traffic to be steady or bursty?
Mostly steady 24x7, but we have predictable spikes (launch windows, promotions) that can be ~4–6x baseline for several hours.

> 3) Timeline: pilot within 90 days (ideally sooner) — we want results before our Black Friday planning window.

Also:
- Integration: Node.js backend with an existing Redis cache layer. Hoping Redwood can fit into our flow with minimal infra changes.
- Success metrics for the pilot: latency <=150ms p50 for common queries, cost per 1k queries under our current vendor baseline.

Any slot on Thu 7/15 at 14:00 PST works for Priya and me. If Jasmine can take that, please send an invite.

—Sam
Sam Wright
Director of Search, Novellus Retail

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: sam.wright@novellus-retail.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — quick context and request

Hi Sam / Priya — great to meet you over email and excited to run the demo. Confirming Thu 2026-07-15 14:00 PST works for us; I'll send a calendar invite in a minute.

Prep notes so the session is targeted to your needs:
- We'll demo: hosted API flow, a dedicated capacity example (throughput/latency tradeoffs), and a short note on cache/batching strategies for Node.js setups.
- Please have one sample query that represents your "p50" use case (we can test latency live).
- If you can share any query volume distribution or a small sample (anonymized), that helps us pick right batch sizes and KV cache heuristics.

A few quick questions (so we can bring the right engineer):
- Do you have an SSO/KMS requirement for the pilot?
- Will you need VPC/private deployment for the POC or is hosted OK at first?
- Who will own verification of latency/cost during the pilot on your side? (name/title)

I'll include Laura from Solutions (cc'd) to help with pilot scoping and post-demo next steps.

Thanks — invite follows shortly.
—Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Thanks Jasmine — quick answers: 
- SSO: yes, we'll need SAML SSO for any long-term deployment, but for the pilot hosted API is OK if we can lock down API keys and IP allowlists.
- VPC: not required for pilot, may consider for production.
- Pilot owner: Priya Gupta (Senior Engineering Manager) will own verification and success metrics.

I'm adding a brief volume breakdown in a small spreadsheet attached (pilot_requirements.xlsx) — it has hourly distribution for the last month and a sample of anonymized queries. Also note our team is distributed — Priya is in Mumbai (IST). The 14:00 PST slot converts to 02:30 IST on Friday, which is a little rough for her. Would you be able to move to one of these alternatives?

- Thu 2026-07-15, 09:00 PST (Evening IST for Priya)
- Fri 2026-07-16, 11:00 PST

If neither works, Priya can dial in at 02:30 IST but wanted to check.

—Sam
